facts.fact: ACSI director general Lord Marhyno Gandou told the National Assembly's Ecofin committee on 17 November 2026 that the state agency ACSI, tasked under the 2025 and 2026 finance laws, has the local-authority revenue platform ready to go into production during 2027.
